history.change: First draft of the document set (prototype B): Overview and Check a record in full; How a record is sealed, Regulatory map, Roadmap and About in outline.

copy.definition: Each result becomes a sealed record: a SHA-256 fingerprint of its recorded fields, linked to the record before it. Batches can be anchored on a public test network, so a later rewrite shows. Only fingerprints go on the network; the values stay with the lab.
copy.status: Independent project · Open alpha · Public test network · Synthetic demo data · No customers yet
copy.regulatory: Built toward the audit-trail expectations of 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11 and ISO/IEC 17025:2017. Not validated. No electronic signatures yet. Not a substitute for your computerized-system validation or SOPs.
copy.footer: Immutable QC is an independent project built on the founder’s own time. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by any employer. Founder: José A. Fernández Abreu · joseqc.com
copy.demoSig: Demo signatures. In the alpha, one server key signs imported rows; per-analyst signatures are on the roadmap.
